name: poppler-qt6
reason: The Qt6 frontend comes from the same Poppler 26.11.0 upstream release as the already-counted Poppler C++ frontend. It exposes another API but would duplicate one package in this cell; the shared Poppler parser family is already recorded.

name: cpdf
reason: The Cpdflib C/C++ API documents cpdf_fromFile and cpdf_pages, but its pinned binary tag v2.5.2a contains a Coherent Graphics noncommercial license and is ineligible. The latest untagged binary repository advertises AGPL, while source-to-binary correspondence for a tagged open-source C/C++ library release remains unresolved; the AGPL OCaml cpdf 2.9 source does not itself expose a built C++ library here.
